items.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11
items.q: His son was a drummer. Hansi. Both of them were drummers.

ctx.x: No. No. Because, let's see. Henry used to play with, he used to play with Jack a lot, Jack Lane.
Well, Jack Lane, when he played a pair, he had to play his own drum. He was a drummer. You see, he was a drummer. His son was a drummer. Hansi. Both of them were drummers.
